reviews.text: I love it the color looks great on me I’m kind of warm toned if you’re Middle Eastern I highly recommend this color very nice and doesn’t dry lips
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意，呢個顏色喺我面上好正。我係偏暖調嘅，如果你係中東人嘅話我好推薦呢個色，超靚，而且唔會令嘴唇乾。

reviews.text: Very soft and glossy lip balm. It melts nicely on the lips and gives a natural glow without feeling sticky. Perfect for everyday makeup and keeps my lips hydrated.
reviews.zh: 非常柔軟而且有光澤嘅潤唇膏。搽上嘴好順地融化，畀到人一種自然嘅光澤又唔會黏笠。啱晒日日化妝用，而且可以保持嘴唇保濕。

reviews.text: The lipstick and the cap does not fit straight. It’s kinda weird to me. I wish I could return it
reviews.zh: 支唇膏同個蓋蓋唔啱位，歪晒。對我嚟講有啲怪。如果可以退貨就好喇。

reviews.text: Really like this balm, it provides lovely colour and moisturises my lips really well. Provides coverage like a lipstick but is much creamier on the lips as a hydrating balm. Definitely going purchase other colours in this range.
reviews.zh: 真係好鍾意呢款潤唇膏，佢畀到好靚嘅顏色，而且保濕效果真係好好。遮色力好似唇膏咁，但係作為保濕潤唇膏，搽上嘴更加滑身。一定會回購呢個系列嘅其他色號。

reviews.text: Love these melting balm. Purchased in various shades. Hydrating.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意呢啲融化感嘅潤唇膏。買咗唔同色號。保濕。

reviews.text: One of the best balm I’ve ever had. 100% recommendation
reviews.zh: 我用過最好嘅潤唇膏之一。100% 推薦。

reviews.text: Glossy and super nice color, also another one that my mom use alot
reviews.zh: 有光澤而且顏色超靚，我媽媽都好常用。

reviews.text: I am addicted to the texture of this balm. I have started carrying it with me everywhere because I love it so much. The color is the perfect nude for me and I love the texture. It is smooth without being sticky and very hydrating. It does seems to stay on my lips for a long time and is very wearable. My only complaint is that takes a long time to twist to raise the balm in the container. I would buy it again though because I love it!
reviews.zh: 我已經中毒咗呢款潤唇膏嘅質地。已經開始周圍帶住佢，因為真係太鍾意。呢個顏色對我嚟講就係最完美嘅裸色，而且我好鍾意佢嘅質地。滑得嚟又唔會黏笠，保濕度都好高。嘴唇上真係keep到好耐，而且好實著。唯一要投訴嘅係要轉好耐先推到唇膏出嚟。不過我一定會再買，因為我真係好鍾意！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
